# Toolset `auth`

Authorization helpers: profile, OAuth login and logout.

**5 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `auth_exchange_code` | `INTERNAL auth:exchange_code` | – | – | Exchange an hh.ru OAuth authorization code for token pair. |
| `auth_get_login_url` | `INTERNAL auth:login_url` | – | – | Get the hh.ru OAuth login URL (manual code copy flow). |
| `auth_logout` | `DELETE /token` | yes | yes | Revoke the hh.ru OAuth token and delete the local profile. |
| `auth_status` | `INTERNAL auth:status` | – | – | Show OAuth configuration and stored token status. |
| `get_me` | `GET /me` | yes | – | Get information about the current hh.ru user (GET /me). |
